BiblicalUsage: Yâshân means old, what has lasted from former days. Jerusalem made a ditch for the water of the old pool, and the law promised Israel they would eat of old fruit until the ninth year.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that old things can still feed God's people, and the old store carries them until the new harvest comes.
